criteria.question: Does every narration cue in this section get a visible beat at about the same moment, showing what is being said?
criteria.pass: Each cue lands within about half a second of its word, and the picture matches the words.
criteria.fail: A cue has no beat, a beat lands clearly early or late, or the visuals show something other than what's being said.

criteria.question: At every moment, is there one clear focal point, so the viewer knows where to look?
criteria.pass: Attention is guided one thing at a time; secondary elements stay quiet.
criteria.fail: Several unrelated things compete at once, or the eye has nothing to follow.

criteria.question: Is all on-screen text legible, high-contrast, on screen long enough to read, and free of collisions with other elements?
criteria.pass: Every label and caption is easy to read and sits on a clean background.
criteria.fail: Text is too small, low-contrast, too brief, clipped, or overlaps shapes or other text.

criteria.question: Is every frame balanced and aligned, inside the safe area, with empty space that looks intentional?
criteria.pass: Elements are aligned and evenly spaced, and nothing is cramped or stranded.
criteria.fail: Awkward crowding, misalignment, elements off-canvas, or large accidental gaps.

criteria.question: Is the motion purposeful and alive: one thing moving at a time, groups staggered, arrivals that settle, and no stretch where the frame is frozen?
criteria.pass: Every movement has a reason; related entrances stagger about 0.2–0.4 s; shapes land with a little overshoot while text and UI only ease; held things keep a slight motion; nothing snaps on or off; something new happens at least every ~4 s.
criteria.fail: Frantic or jarring motion, several things starting at once, objects snapping on or off with no transition, a frozen frame for more than ~2.5 s, or bouncing UI.

criteria.question: Does the section follow the style guide (colour meanings, sparse text, motion personality)?
criteria.pass: Colours mean what the guide says they mean, text is sparse, and the motion feels like the rest of the video.
criteria.fail: Colour meanings are broken (e.g. red used for something other than failure), there's too much text, or the motion is off-tone.

criteria.question: Is the visual explanation technically correct, without misleading the viewer about the concept?
criteria.pass: The metaphor matches how the real system behaves.
criteria.fail: The visuals imply something false or confusing about the concept.

overall.question: Would you ship this section as-is?
overall.pass: Yes: good enough to publish without edits.
overall.fail: No: it needs at least one change.
